title: Export with dependencies is missing global classes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.1.4.stable.official [fe0e8e557], v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6], v4.5.stable.arch_linux, v4.5.1.rc1.official [c834443ef], v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable unknown - EndeavourOS # 1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 02 Oct 2025 13:18:36 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1280P (20 threads) - 31.05 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the "Export selected scenes (and dependencies)" option, I would expect it to export my game such that classes which are referenced by name in any script I use in a scene or resource are exported.

However, when using this option, such classes are not exported:

```
Godot Engine v4.5.stable.official.876b29033 - https://godotengine.org
Inconsistent value (1) for DRI_PRIME. Should be < 1 (GPU devices count). Using: 0
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.2.4-arch1.1 - Compatibility - Using Device: Intel - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2)

SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Could not find script for class "Storage".
          at: GDScript::reload (res://main.gd:4)
SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Cannot infer the type of "storage" variable because the value doesn't have a set type.
          at: GDScript::reload (res://main.gd:4)
ERROR: Failed to load script "res://main.gd" with error "Parse error".
   at: load (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:3041)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a class `A`.
2. Create another class `B` which creates an instance of `A` on ready.
3. Use `B` in a scene.
4. Export the game in release mode using the "Export selected scenes (and dependencies)" option with that scene selected.
5. Observe that the exported game fails to find class `A`.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[global-class.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22782919/global-class.zip)
